ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the images: In Figure A there are two horizontal guide rails, the left end is connected to a fixed resistor R, there is a metal rod CD between the rails, the position where the rod is located is marked near the starting point, and there is an arrow in the x direction to the right; the magnetic field region is represented by a dot array, indicating that the magnetic field is perpendicular to the paper surface outward, and the spacing between the rails is marked as L. Figure B is a v-x graph, the vertical axis is v/(m·s^-1), the horizontal axis is x/m, and the graph line starts from the origin and is a straight line; the dashed lines mark that when x=1 m, v=2 m/s, so within 0 to 1 m it can be read that v=2x. Then reason: During the motion of the metal rod, the work done by the pulling force is used to increase kinetic energy, do work to overcome friction, and do work to overcome the ampere resistance. It is known that R=2 Ω, r=2 Ω, so the total resistance R+r=4 Ω; B=1 T, L=1 m. The final speed v=2 m/s, and the increment of kinetic energy ΔEk=(1/2)mv^2=(1/2)×2×2^2=4 J. The friction force f=μmg=0.25×2×10=5 N, the displacement is 1 m, and the work done to overcome friction Wf=5×1=5 J. The induced electromotive force E=BLv, the current I=BLv/(R+r), and the ampere resistance FA=BIL=B^2L^2v/(R+r)=v/4. From the graph v=2x, so the work done to overcome the ampere resistance WA=∫0^1 (v/4) dx=∫0^1 (2x/4) dx=0.25 J. By the kinetic energy theorem, the work done by the pulling force W=ΔEk+Wf+WA=4+5+0.25=9.25 J.

method.method_draft: 先读图像：图甲显示金属棒在水平导轨中向右运动并切割垂直纸面向外的匀强磁场，图乙显示0到1 m内速度随位移近似直线增加，且过(0,0)、(1,2)，所以v=2x。再读文字参数：m=2 kg，R+r=4 Ω，B=1 T，L=1 m，μ=0.25。采用牛顿第二定律先求拉力F(x)：由v=2x得dv/dx=2，加速度a=dv/dt=v(dv/dx)=4x。摩擦力为μmg=5 N，安培阻力为B^2L^2v/(R+r)=v/4=x/2。沿运动方向列方程F-f-F_A=ma，得F(x)=ma+f+F_A=2·4x+5+x/2=5+8.5x。拉力做功为W=∫_0^1F(x)dx=∫_0^1(5+8.5x)dx=5+4.25=9.25 J。

verify_reports.critic_suggestions: 推理过程与图像、题干参数、标准答案和方法草稿均一致；图像描述在前、物理推理在后，满足多模态顺序要求。仅有很小措辞可优化：图中m、r是标在金属棒附近用于表示其质量和电阻，不必说成严格“棒上标有”。

raw_record.original_question: 如图甲所示，左侧接有定值电阻R=2 Ω的水平粗糙导轨处于垂直纸面向外的匀强磁场中，磁感应强度B=1 T，导轨间距L=1 m。一质量m=2 kg、阻值r=2 Ω的金属棒在水平拉力F作用下由静止开始从CD处沿导轨向右加速运动，金属棒的v-x图象如图乙所示。若金属棒与导轨间动摩擦因数μ=0.25，则金属棒从起点发生x=1 m位移的过程中，拉力做的功W是多少？
raw_record.answer: The work done by the pulling force W=9.25 J
raw_record.final_cot: First describe the images: In Figure A there are two horizontal guide rails, the left end is connected to a fixed resistor R, there is a metal rod CD between the rails, the position where the rod is located is marked near the starting point, and there is an arrow in the x direction to the right; the magnetic field region is represented by a dot array, indicating that the magnetic field is perpendicular to the paper surface outward, and the spacing between the rails is marked as L. Figure B is a v-x graph, the vertical axis is v/(m·s^-1), the horizontal axis is x/m, and the graph line starts from the origin and is a straight line; the dashed lines mark that when x=1 m, v=2 m/s, so within 0 to 1 m it can be read that v=2x. Then reason: During the motion of the metal rod, the work done by the pulling force is used to increase kinetic energy, do work to overcome friction, and do work to overcome the ampere resistance. It is known that R=2 Ω, r=2 Ω, so the total resistance R+r=4 Ω; B=1 T, L=1 m. The final speed v=2 m/s, and the increment of kinetic energy ΔEk=(1/2)mv^2=(1/2)×2×2^2=4 J. The friction force f=μmg=0.25×2×10=5 N, the displacement is 1 m, and the work done to overcome friction Wf=5×1=5 J. The induced electromotive force E=BLv, the current I=BLv/(R+r), and the ampere resistance FA=BIL=B^2L^2v/(R+r)=v/4. From the graph v=2x, so the work done to overcome the ampere resistance WA=∫0^1 (v/4) dx=∫0^1 (2x/4) dx=0.25 J. By the kinetic energy theorem, the work done by the pulling force W=ΔEk+Wf+WA=4+5+0.25=9.25 J.

ready3_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in Figure A, the horizontal rough guide rails on the left side connected to a fixed resistor R=2 Ω are in a uniform magnetic field perpendicular to the paper surface outward, with magnetic induction intensity B=1 T and rail spacing L=1 m. A metal rod with mass m=2 kg and resistance r=2 Ω starts from rest at CD and accelerates to the right along the rails under the action of a horizontal pulling force F. The v-x graph of the metal rod is shown in Figure B. If the coefficient of kinetic friction between the metal rod and the rails is μ=0.25, then during the process in which the metal rod undergoes a displacement x=1 m from the starting point, how much is the work W done by the pulling force?
ready3_open_rewrite.raw_answer: The work done by the pulling force W=9.25 J
ready3_open_rewrite.raw_standard_answer: The work done by the pulling force W=9.25 J
